tracks.title: Better By You Better Than Me

verdict.detail: Discogs lists 3 variants of it; the run-outs and label details tell the earliest.

physical: Pressed by CBS Pressing Plant, Aston Clinton

notes.text:
CBS 'Sunburst' labels.
Gloss sleeve.
Black/red printed inner sleeve with line-up, credits etc. This inner sleeve is of top opening card and has curved  bottom corners, bevelled top corners plus a curved die cut thumb section.
Some copies came with a gold stamp identifying them as copies used for promotional purposes.
Some copies came with an A5 order sheet for Judas Priest T-shirts by Brockum International, Oxford, bearing catalog number CBS 82430 as well. 

All selections published by Arnakata Music Ltd. except A3 published by Blue Mountain Music Ltd.

© 1978 CBS Records ℗ 1978 CBS Records
Made in England.

Runouts are etched apart from stamped letters or numbers following
